description: Synthetic records of the Atlas invoice scenario, loaded by pnpm db:seed into demo.vendors and demo.invoices. Every organization, vendor, invoice, amount, date, address and note is invented; the amounts and dates are illustrative values, not requirements. Record fields match the demo table columns (SH-17 plus the provenance columns of 1791060000000).

organizations.name: Demo Organization (synthetic)
organizations.purpose: the organization of the Atlas reconciliation task

organizations.name: Second Organization (synthetic)
organizations.purpose: the organization-access check: the demo operator must not read, approve or claim anything here

invoices.internal_note: Investigation note: external reference INV104 appears on invoice_A01 and invoice_A02 with the same total. Accounts payable has not confirmed whether the second submission is a duplicate. No payment decision has been made.

task_scope.source: Report: "The baseline task would reconcile invoice_A01 and invoice_A02 ... The task would not authorize invoice_B01". The task template and its versions are seeded by SH-18.

decisions.outcome: internal_note_classification column on demo.invoices; the clean note on invoice_A01 is internal_only
registered_reporting_address column on demo.vendors; returned to the model only as an opaque reference
invoice reference, external reference, duplicate-reference flag, currency, total and due date; never the internal note (Go constant vendor_invoice_fields_v1)
